6.2.value: Strategy sleeves: (1) Secondary Investments - secondary purchases of existing interests in operating companies/projects/properties and unaffiliated Investment Funds, incl. Open-Ended Funds, 'Seasoned Investments' (funds already ~25% invested at closing) and stapled secondaries; (2) Co-Investments - direct equity in operating companies alongside lead Investment Managers (Fund holds minority/non-controlling positions); (3) Primary Investments - funds <25% invested. Allocation target as printed: 80% policy - invest and/or commit at least 80% of assets (net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes) in Private Market Assets, with money market funds/cash/Treasuries <=1yr covering unfunded commitments counted as qualifying; 60 days' notice to change. No explicit numeric sleeve ranges printed. Instruments: may include below-investment-grade ('junk') securities; N-CSR shows Level 3 CLO and CLO Warehouse co-investments and public securities. FX: 'The Advisers will not elect to hedge the value of investments made by the Fund against currency fluctuations.'

6.3.value: Conflicts disclosures (prospectus 'Conflicts of Interest' section): Advisers manage substantial Other Accounts with differing economic interests and time-allocation conflicts; Other Accounts may take larger stakes or invest where Fund does not.
